_comment: Room artwork, shared by the app (src/room/art.ts) and the backend (backend/app/pet_room.py), so the room on screen and the saved photo are drawn from the same shapes. Each room kind (`rooms`) has its canvas (personal: `top`, where its content starts below the app's header, and `bleed`, how far its wall and floor are drawn around the canvas so a screen of any shape is filled; `petScale`, the size of its pets against the furniture), areas, feet range, pet spots and vignette; the floor starts at floorY. Surfaces fill the wall or the floor: `svg` for the 420-wide personal room (over its bleed), `focus` for the 640-wide focus room. Items are drawn around their anchor (floor and top items: feet at 0,0; wall items and rugs: centre at 0,0); @tokens are filled from the chosen variant. `box` is the item's extent around the anchor (without glows). `tops` are the flat surfaces of a support, [x0, x1, dy] around its anchor before flipping, where `top` items stand. An item the pet sits behind (the desk) also has `cover`: the part of its drawing in front of the seat, drawn again over the seated pet. `palettes` set wall, floor and each item's first `prefer` variant; `defaults` are the rooms a new user starts with. Ids of surfaces, items and variants are stored in saved rooms: only ever add.
